name: B10-0445/2025 – § 16 – Am 5
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: 16. Notes that the EU and its Member States provide roughly one third of global public climate finance, making them the largest providers globally, with EUR 28.6 billion provided from public sources in 2023 and EUR 7.2 billion in private finance also mobilised1a; calls for a thorough assessment of the effectiveness of such expenditure and its proportionality, in the light of the EU Member States’ share of global emissions, which amounted to only 5.95 % in 20241b; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Council of the EU and the European Council, ‘Europe’s contribution to climate finance (in €bn)’, Council of the EU and European Council website, 1 October 2025. 1b Crippa, M., Guizzardi, D., Pagani, F., Banja, M., Muntean, M. et al., GHG emissions of all world countries - 2025 Report, Publications Office of the European Union, Luxembourg, 2025.
